hero_lead: From the first photo to the final quality check, Showtime gives mountain drivers clear answers, insurance support, and a repair they can trust.
review1_quote: The customer service was awesome. Just picked up my car and it’s absolutely perfect. Showtime knows how to make a happy customer.
review2_quote: Absolutely outstanding service. Car literally looks better than the day I bought it. Could not be more satisfied.
review3_quote: Their attention to detail erased all of my anxiety and made me feel like I was family.
faq1_question: Can I receive a final repair price from photos alone?
faq1_answer: Photos are useful for an initial review, but hidden damage, scans, measurements, and disassembly may be needed before the final repair plan is known.
faq2_question: Can Showtime work with my insurance company?
faq2_answer: Yes we work with all insurance companies. You have the right to choose your repair facility.
faq3_question: What should I prepare for the online estimate?
faq3_answer: Use a mobile phone, have the vehicle accessible, and be ready to capture the guided photos requested by Carwise.
faq4_question: Do I need an appointment to visit?
faq4_answer: Calling ahead or starting the photo estimate is the smoothest path. Appointments are available upon request, and walk-in availability depends on the shop schedule.
faq5_question: Which vehicle makes is Showtime OEM certified to repair?
faq5_answer: We are currently certified in Subaru, Ford, Honda, Acura, Nissan, Infiniti, Hyundai, Kia, Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram, Fiat, Chevrolet, GMC, Buick, and Cadillac. Certification applies to the Running Springs production facility.
faq6_question: Where can I start in person?
faq6_answer: Full collision repair is performed at 32049 Encina Way, Running Springs, CA 92382. Big Bear also has a staffed satellite facility where customers can begin intake, get the process started, and arrange an on-site rental car.
